easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Sceptre of Eternal Glory and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Sceptre of Eternal Glory and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
